title: Audits, reviews and harness release per project
goal: The owner sees which projects are due an audit or review, or behind the harness
acceptance: Per project: newest audit manifest against `audit.days`, `reviews.<name>.days` against `docs/reviews/`
Per project: its `.harness.json` version against the latest template release, behind ones flagged
Fixtures for a current and an overdue project and one behind the harness
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: Missing evidence reads as unknown, never as current

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement. Moved from F-095-T07 on 2026-11-24 when the owner split F-095.
